text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Collapsed building kills 20 people in Enugu, eastern Nigeria and owner of the building escapes unhurt.
- Calm all over Nigeria on June 12, the fourth anniversary of annulled 1993 presidential election.
- Nigerian government official says there is no justification for new bill in U.S. congress to bar American investment in Nigeria.
- Nigeria, Sierra Leonean coup makers begin talks in Freetown in diplomatic effort to reinstate elected president Ahmad Tejan Kabbah, who was toppled by the soldiers on May 25.

- Lagos state military administrator Colonel Mohammed Marwa lays foundation stone of a one billion naira housing project in the state capital Ikeja, saying it will ease accomodation problem in the area.
- Nigeria demands immediate review of eight-year-old shareholders agreement of the $4 billion liquefied natural gas project.
- Forex demand slides further to $44.345 million this week from $54.787 million last week.
